+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Export an actual MHD ecliptic slice, with projected solar-system geometry."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import argparse, json
+import numpy as np
+import matplotlib
+matplotlib.use('Agg')
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+from matplotlib.animation import FuncAnimation, FFMpegWriter, PillowWriter
+from matplotlib.colors import LogNorm
+from matplotlib.patches import Circle
+from scipy.interpolate import RegularGridInterpolator
+from astropy.time import Time
+from astropy.coordinates import get_body_barycentric
+
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+def main():
+    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--case',default='medium');p.add_argument('--gif',action='store_true');args=p.parse_args()
+    folder=ROOT/'results'/args.case
+    records=np.genfromtxt(folder/'snapshots.csv',delimiter=',',names=True,dtype=None,encoding='utf8')
+    r,th,ph=[np.load(folder/f'{name}.npy') for name in ['r_au','theta_rad','phi_rad']]
+    basis=np.array(json.loads((ROOT/'observations/coordinate_system.json').read_text())['ecliptic_to_solar_equatorial_matrix'])
+    axis=np.linspace(-2.3,2.3,460)
+    xx,yy=np.meshgrid(axis,axis)
+    flat=np.column_stack([xx.ravel(),yy.ravel(),np.zeros(xx.size)])@basis.T
+    rr=np.linalg.norm(flat,axis=1)
+    theta=np.arccos(np.divide(flat[:,2],rr,out=np.zeros_like(rr),where=rr>0))
+    phi=np.arctan2(flat[:,1],flat[:,0])%(2*np.pi)
+    points=np.column_stack([rr,theta,phi])
+    extended_phi=np.r_[ph[-1]-2*np.pi,ph,ph[0]+2*np.pi]
+    def slice_flux(filename):
+        a=np.load(folder/filename)
+        # Interpolate scalar density and vector speed separately to avoid
+        # interpreting a theta component as a Cartesian direction.
+        flux=a[...,0]*np.linalg.norm(a[...,1:4],axis=-1)*1e5
+        flux=np.concatenate([flux[...,-1:],flux,flux[...,:1]],axis=-1)
+        interp=RegularGridInterpolator((r,th,extended_phi),flux,bounds_error=False,fill_value=np.nan)
+        return interp(points).reshape(xx.shape)
+    times=records['day']; dates=Time(times+60980,format='mjd',scale='utc')
+    eps=np.deg2rad(84381.448/3600); rot=np.array([[1,0,0],[0,np.cos(eps),np.sin(eps)],[0,-np.sin(eps),np.cos(eps)]])
+    sun=get_body_barycentric('sun',dates)
+    tracks={}
+    for name in ['mercury','venus','earth','mars']:
+        tracks[name]=((get_body_barycentric(name,dates)-sun).xyz.value.T@rot.T)
+    for name in ['comet','stereo_a','solar_orbiter']:
+        a=np.genfromtxt(ROOT/'observations'/f'ephemeris_{name}.tsv',delimiter='\t',names=True,dtype=None,encoding='utf8')
+        tracks[name]=np.column_stack([np.interp(times+60980,a['mjd_utc'],a[k]) for k in ['x_au','y_au','z_au']])
+    plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':10,'text.color':'#e6edf6','axes.labelcolor':'#e6edf6',
+        'xtick.color':'#c0cbd9','ytick.color':'#c0cbd9','axes.edgecolor':'#48536a','savefig.facecolor':'#0b101b'})
+    fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.2,8.5),facecolor='#0b101b',layout='constrained');ax.set_facecolor('#0b101b')
+    cmap=plt.get_cmap('magma').copy();cmap.set_bad('#0b101b')
+    initial=slice_flux(records['file'][0])
+    im=ax.imshow(initial,origin='lower',extent=[-2.3,2.3,-2.3,2.3],cmap=cmap,norm=LogNorm(1e7,3e10),interpolation='bilinear')
+    cb=fig.colorbar(im,ax=ax,fraction=.045,pad=.025);cb.set_label(r'Proton flux $n_p|v_{SW}|$ (cm$^{-2}$ s$^{-1}$)')
+    for rad in [.5,1,1.5,2]:
+        ax.add_patch(Circle((0,0),rad,fill=False,ec='#d6e2f4',lw=.6,alpha=.28))
+    ax.plot(0,0,'o',color='#ffd464',markersize=9,label='Sun',zorder=10)
+    colors={'mercury':'#a6a9ad','venus':'#ffe1b8','earth':'#75c6ff','mars':'#ff927b',
+        'comet':'#82ffd4','stereo_a':'#f7f1a1','solar_orbiter':'#ecbcff'}
+    names={'mercury':'Mercury','venus':'Venus','earth':'Earth / Wind','mars':'Mars','comet':'3I/ATLAS','stereo_a':'STEREO-A','solar_orbiter':'Solar Orbiter'}
+    markers={}; labels={}
+    for name,track in tracks.items():
+        ax.plot(track[:,0],track[:,1],color=colors[name],lw=.65,alpha=.6)
+        markers[name],=ax.plot([track[0,0]],[track[0,1]],'D' if name=='comet' else 'o',ms=5.5 if name=='comet' else 4,color=colors[name],zorder=8)
+        labels[name]=ax.annotate(names[name],track[0,:2],xytext=(6,6),textcoords='offset points',color=colors[name],fontsize=8,zorder=10)
+    title=ax.set_title('',loc='left',fontsize=13,weight='bold',pad=12)
+    ax.set(xlim=(-2.3,2.3),ylim=(-2.3,2.3),xlabel='Heliocentric ecliptic J2000 x (AU)',ylabel='Heliocentric ecliptic J2000 y (AU)',aspect='equal')
+    ax.text(.02,.02,'Ecliptic slice of the 3D MHD solution\nMarkers are projected; comet samples use its actual latitude.',transform=ax.transAxes,color='#d1dbe9',fontsize=8,va='bottom',bbox={'facecolor':'#0b101b','alpha':.70,'edgecolor':'none','pad':5})
+    def frame(i):
+        im.set_data(slice_flux(records['file'][i]))
+        for name,track in tracks.items():
+            markers[name].set_data([track[i,0]],[track[i,1]]);labels[name].xy=track[i,:2]
+        stamp=dates[i].isot[:16].replace('T',' ')
+        title.set_text(f'Solar-wind propagation to 2.3 AU | {stamp} UTC')
+        return [im,title,*markers.values(),*labels.values()]
+    frame(0)
+    animation=FuncAnimation(fig,frame,frames=len(records),interval=160,blit=False)
+    dest=ROOT/'figures';dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    animation.save(dest/'solar_wind_topdown.mp4',writer=FFMpegWriter(fps=6,codec='libx264',bitrate=1800,extra_args=['-threads','2','-pix_fmt','yuv420p']),dpi=120)
+    if args.gif: animation.save(dest/'solar_wind_topdown.gif',writer=PillowWriter(fps=6),dpi=75)
+    index=int(np.argmin(abs(times-32.75)));frame(index);fig.savefig(dest/'solar_wind_topdown.png',dpi=180)

+        'snapshots_are_simulation_data':True},indent=2)+'\n')
+    print('Animation and preview written:',dest)
+
+if __name__=='__main__': main()
*** End Patch"));
